facts.text: The hotel is in a restored historic building in Fitzrovia, close to Soho, Mayfair and Covent Garden.
facts.excerpt: Located in a beautifully restored historic building in Fitzrovia, just moments from Soho, Mayfair, and Covent Garden

facts.text: The hotel reflects the design vision of Ian Schrager.
facts.excerpt: blends timeless elegance with modern sophistication, reflecting Ian Schrager

facts.text: Guest rooms use oak floors, wood-paneled walls and photography by Hendrik Kerstens to create a cabin-like feel, like a private yacht.
facts.excerpt: Oak floors, wood-paneled walls, custom furnishings and evocative photography from Hendrik Kerstens create a cabin-like feel, akin to that of a private yacht

facts.text: Rooms and suites have nautical-inspired accents and bespoke furnishings.
facts.excerpt: Each room and suite is thoughtfully designed with nautical-inspired accents, bespoke furnishings, and contemporary comforts.

facts.text: Suites come with a complimentary gin trolley.
facts.excerpt: suites offer a complimentary gin trolley for a touch of elegance

facts.text: The Berners Tavern dining room has chandeliers inspired by those in New York's Grand Central Station.
facts.excerpt: the space is crowned by breathtaking chandeliers inspired by those in New York’s Grand Central Station

facts.text: Berners Tavern is led by chef Jason Atherton and serves contemporary British food.
facts.excerpt: Berners Tavern, helmed by acclaimed chef Jason Atherton, seamlessly combines historical charm with modern sophistication.

facts.text: The Punch Room is an intimate, speakeasy-style cocktail bar.
facts.excerpt: retreat to the award-winning Punch Room for a more intimate, speakeasy-style experience

facts.text: The Lobby Bar has a communal table, tufted sofas and a snooker table.
facts.excerpt: overlooks intimate seating areas with tufted sofas and a snooker table.

facts.text: The Penthouse has a wrap-around landscaped terrace with views of London.
facts.excerpt: Penthouse with expansive wrap-around landscaped terrace and 360 degree views of London

facts.text: The Private Dining Room sits above Berners Tavern and is lit by an original historic skylight.
facts.excerpt: Situated above Berners Tavern, our Private Dining Room offers an intimate and refined setting for up to 12 guests

facts.text: The Private Dining Room is lit by an original historic skylight.
facts.excerpt: this space is illuminated by an original historic skylight

facts.text: Select rooms and suites can be connected to form two-bedroom configurations.
facts.excerpt: select rooms and suites at The London EDITION can be connected to form expansive two-bedroom configurations

facts.text: Guests get complimentary use of the fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary use of the 24-hour fitness centre

facts.text: The hotel is within the Congestion Charge and Ultra-Low Emission Zone.
facts.excerpt: our Hotel is within the Congestion Charge and Ultra-Low Emission Zone

facts.text: Parking is available at Q-Park on Poland Street, a 5-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Parking is available at Q-Park on Poland Street and is a 5-minute walk from The London EDITION.

facts.text: Mobility accessible rooms are available for certain room types.
facts.excerpt: Mobility accessible rooms available for certain room types

facts.text: From Heathrow, the Elizabeth line to Tottenham Court Road station leads to the hotel on foot.
facts.excerpt: Get off at Tottenham Court Road station
